questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: If $29\text{ mmol}$ of a solute is dissolved completely to form $80\text{ mL}$ of aqueous solution, what is the molarity of the resulting solution?
questions.explanation: Apply stoichiometric & molar equivalence relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Nernst Equation & Concentration Cell).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a quantitative redox conversion, $30\text{ moles}$ of a reagent undergo a change in oxidation number of $2$ units per formula unit. How many Faradays of electricity are required for this conversion?
questions.explanation: Apply stoichiometric & molar equivalence relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Faraday Laws of Electrolysis).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For a chemical reaction at constant temperature and pressure, $\Delta H^\circ = -310\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$ and $T\Delta S^\circ = +15\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$. What is the standard Gibbs free energy change $\Delta G^\circ$?
questions.solution: $\Delta G^\circ = \Delta H^\circ - T\Delta S^\circ = -310 - 15 = -325\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$.
questions.explanation: Apply thermodynamic & energetic balance relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Kohlrausch Law & Molar Conductance).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Given two elementary thermochemical steps with $\Delta H_1^\circ = +128\text{ kJ/mol}$ and $\Delta H_2^\circ = -24\text{ kJ/mol}$, determine $\Delta H^\circ$ for the overall reaction obtained by $2 \times (\text{Step 1}) + (\text{Step 2})$.
questions.explanation: Apply thermodynamic & energetic balance relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Disproportionation Equivalents).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For a reversible elementary reaction $A \rightleftharpoons B$, the forward rate constant is $k_f = 165\text{ s}^{-1}$ and the reverse rate constant is $k_b = 5\text{ s}^{-1}$. Find the equilibrium constant $K_c$.
questions.explanation: Apply equilibrium & extent of reaction relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Nernst Equation & Concentration Cell).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: One mole of an electrolyte dissociates in solution to yield $6$ ions per formula unit with a degree of dissociation $\alpha = 0.5$. Calculate its Van't Hoff factor $i$.
questions.explanation: Apply equilibrium & extent of reaction relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Faraday Laws of Electrolysis).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A reaction has a constant half-life of $35\text{ min}$ independent of initial concentration. How much time is required for the reactant concentration to fall to $\frac{1}{2^{7}}$ of its initial value?
questions.explanation: Apply kinetic rate & half-life analysis relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Kohlrausch Law & Molar Conductance).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: When the initial concentration of reactant $X$ is increased by a factor of $8$, the initial rate of reaction increases by a factor of $64$. What is the order of the reaction with respect to $X$?
questions.solution: Since $r \propto [X]^n$ and $(8)^n = 64$, the reaction order is $n = 2$.
questions.explanation: Apply kinetic rate & half-life analysis relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Disproportionation Equivalents).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: How many radial nodes are present in an atomic orbital characterized by principal quantum number $n = 4$ and azimuthal quantum number $l = 1$?
questions.solution: Number of radial nodes $= n - l - 1 = (4) - (1) - 1 = 2$.
questions.explanation: Apply electronic structure & quantum rules relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Nernst Equation & Concentration Cell).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A transition metal ion in its ground state possesses $n = 3$ unpaired electrons. What is its spin-only magnetic moment in Bohr Magnetons ($\text{BM}$)?
questions.explanation: Apply electronic structure & quantum rules relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Faraday Laws of Electrolysis).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A central main-group atom forms $4$ $\sigma$-bonds with surrounding monovalent atoms and retains $1$ non-bonding lone pair. What is the steric number of the central atom?
questions.explanation: Apply bonding, hybridization & polarity relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Kohlrausch Law & Molar Conductance).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A homonuclear diatomic species contains $10$ electrons in bonding molecular orbitals and $6$ electrons in antibonding molecular orbitals. What is its bond order?
questions.explanation: Apply bonding, hybridization & polarity relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Disproportionation Equivalents).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a binary ideal liquid mixture at constant temperature, pure liquid $A$ has vapor pressure $P_A^\circ = 820\text{ Torr}$ and its mole fraction in the liquid phase is $x_A = 0.5$. Find the partial vapor pressure of $A$ above the solution.
questions.solution: By Raoult's law, $P_A = x_A P_A^\circ = 0.5 \times 820 = 410\text{ Torr}$.
questions.explanation: Apply colligative & phase behavior relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Nernst Equation & Concentration Cell).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A dilute solution of a non-volatile non-electrolyte has molality $m = 7\text{ mol kg}^{-1}$ in a solvent with $K_b = 0.52\text{ K kg mol}^{-1}$. Calculate the elevation in boiling point $\Delta T_b$.
questions.explanation: Apply colligative & phase behavior relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Faraday Laws of Electrolysis).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a galvanic cell at $298\text{ K}$, the standard reduction potentials of the cathode and anode half-cells are $+4.30\text{ V}$ and $-0.80\text{ V}$ respectively. Determine $E_{\text{cell}}^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Apply electrochemical potential & nernst relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Kohlrausch Law & Molar Conductance).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: At $298\text{ K}$ (where $\frac{2.303 RT}{F} = 0.059\text{ V}$), an $n$-electron redox half-reaction has $n = 2$. How does the electrode potential change when the reaction quotient $Q$ increases by a factor of $10^{2}$?
questions.explanation: Apply electrochemical potential & nernst relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Disproportionation Equivalents).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the polyatomic oxo-anion $\text{XO}_{3}^{2-}$ where each oxygen atom is in the $-2$ oxidation state, what is the oxidation state of the central atom $\text{X}$?
questions.solution: Let oxidation state of $\text{X}$ be $x$: $x + 3(-2) = -2 \implies x = +4$.
questions.explanation: Apply periodic trends & oxidation states relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Nernst Equation & Concentration Cell).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: If the effective nuclear charge $Z_{\text{eff}}$ increases by $0.65$ units for each unit increase in atomic number across a period, what is the cumulative increase in $Z_{\text{eff}}$ across $4$ consecutive main-group elements in that period?
questions.solution: Across 4 consecutive elements there are 3 steps, giving $\Delta Z_{\text{eff}} = 0.65 \times 3 = 1.95$.
questions.explanation: Apply periodic trends & oxidation states relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Faraday Laws of Electrolysis).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: An octahedral complex $[\text{M}(\text{L})_6]^{n+}$ containing a $d^1$ metal ion has an octahedral splitting parameter $\Delta_o = 47000\text{ cm}^{-1}$. What is the magnitude of its Crystal Field Stabilization Energy?
questions.solution: For $t_{2g}^1 e_g^0$ in an octahedral field, $|\text{CFSE}| = 0.4\Delta_o = 18800\text{ cm}^{-1}$.
questions.explanation: Apply coordination & crystal field theory relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Kohlrausch Law & Molar Conductance).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A neutral chelating ligand of denticity $6$ forms a homoleptic complex with a metal ion whose coordination number is $12$. How many ligand molecules are coordinated to the metal ion?
questions.explanation: Apply coordination & crystal field theory relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Disproportionation Equivalents).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: An unsymmetrical organic molecule possesses $n = 3$ chiral centers and has no plane, center, or alternating axis of symmetry. How many optically active stereoisomers can it form?
questions.solution: For an unsymmetrical molecule with $n = 3$ chiral centers, total optically active isomers $= 2^n = 8$.
questions.explanation: Apply stereochemistry & isomeric counting relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Nernst Equation & Concentration Cell).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the Degree of Unsaturation (Double Bond Equivalent) of a hydrocarbon having the molecular formula $\text{C}_{50}\text{H}_{98}$?
questions.explanation: Apply stereochemistry & isomeric counting relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Faraday Laws of Electrolysis).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a two-step synthesis starting from $51\text{ moles}$ of reactant, the first step has an $80\%$ yield and the second step has a $75\%$ yield. How many moles of final product are isolated?
questions.solution: Overall yield $= 0.80 \times 0.75 = 0.60$. Moles of product $= 0.60 \times 51 = 30.60\text{ mol}$.
questions.explanation: Apply reaction mechanism & selectivity relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Kohlrausch Law & Molar Conductance).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A chemical reaction produces two regioisomers in the molar ratio $3 : 1$. What is the percentage composition of the major regioisomer in the product mixture?
questions.explanation: Apply reaction mechanism & selectivity relations in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry (Disproportionation Equivalents).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: When $29$ moles of a substance with $n$-factor $8$ react completely, what is the total number of chemical equivalents reacted?
questions.explanation: Apply numerical stoichiometric equivalents in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Three consecutive steps of a thermochemical cycle have enthalpy changes $+120\text{ kJ}$, $-2\text{ kJ}$, and $+4\text{ kJ}$. Calculate the net enthalpy change $\Delta H_{\text{net}}$ in kJ.
questions.explanation: Apply numerical enthalpy & free energy in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: How many atomic orbitals in total (excluding electron spin) belong to the principal quantum shell $n = 3$?
questions.explanation: Apply numerical quantum & nodal count in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the homoleptic metal carbonyl $\text{M}(\text{CO})_{4}$, each $\text{CO}$ ligand donates $2$ electrons to the metal center. What is the total number of electrons donated by the ligands?
questions.explanation: Apply numerical oxidation & coordination number in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Determine the Degree of Unsaturation (DBE) of an organic compound having the molecular formula $\text{C}_{38}\text{H}_{66}\text{O}_2$.
questions.explanation: Apply numerical degree of unsaturation in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A zero-order reaction has rate constant $k = 2\text{ M s}^{-1}$ and initial reactant concentration $[A]_0 = 136\text{ M}$. Calculate its half-life $t_{1/2}$ in seconds.
questions.explanation: Apply numerical kinetics & half-life in Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry.
